plugins.name: idle-compact
plugins.description: Compact the conversation once after 40 idle minutes, while the 1h prompt cache is still warm.

plugins.name: review-threads
plugins.description: Respond to GitHub pull request review threads: list unresolved threads, reply, resolve and edit replies through one gh-based script.

plugins.name: rebase
plugins.description: Rebase in the main conversation and delegate conflict resolution to a subagent only when conflicts occur, keeping conflict diffs out of the main context.

plugins.name: circleci-triage
plugins.description: Triage failing CircleCI tests: fetch failures with the circleci CLI in a subagent, tell flaky from regression, and propose a fix.

plugins.name: project-memory
plugins.description: Inject a per-project RULES.md and the memory index at session start, and compact MEMORY.md without dropping a single link.

plugins.name: desktop-notify
plugins.description: GNOME desktop notifications for Claude Code, titled with the session name or git branch so you can tell sessions apart.

plugins.name: session-prs
plugins.description: List the pull requests created in this session in a band above the prompt, and every recorded PR with the session that created it.
